config.forge.apiKeys.anthropic.descripti: Anthropic API key (falls back to ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var).
config.forge.apiKeys.google.description: Google Generative AI API key (falls back to GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY env var).
config.forge.apiKeys.openai.description: OpenAI API key (falls back to OPENAI_API_KEY env var).
config.forge.audit.enabled.description: Append a redacted record of every agent run and tool call to ~/.forge/audit.log (one JSON object per line).
config.forge.browser.enabled.description: Give the agent browser tools (open a page, screenshot, read console errors). Needs Chrome, Edge or Chromium; set FORGE_CHROME_PATH to override.
config.forge.browser.headless.descriptio: Run the agent's browser without a visible window.
config.forge.suggestSpec.description: Offer to draft a spec (or plan first) when a chat message asks for a whole system, such as "build a CRM".
config.forge.approvalDefault.description: How much new chats do without asking: ask, edits or auto. Autonomous applies only in trusted workspaces; unset shows the first-run card.
config.forge.chat.promptHistory.descript: Which earlier prompts the up and down arrows bring back in the chat box: shared across all chats, or only this chat's.
config.forge.chat.showSpeed.description: Show how many tokens per second each reply was written at, next to the reply.
config.forge.chatViewEnabled.description: Show the Forge chat view in the sidebar.
config.forge.checkpoints.captureCommands: Also capture a checkpoint before each run_command. Snapshots the whole workspace each time: slow on large repos.
config.forge.checkpoints.enabled.descrip: Capture a checkpoint before each agent file edit in the chat so it can be restored from the Checkpoints panel.
config.forge.compaction.enabled.descript: Summarize older turns when the conversation nears the model's context window, so long chats keep working.
config.forge.context.budgetTokens.descri: Largest prompt (in tokens) Forge is willing to send on each step. When the conversation reaches it, older turns are summarized, even if the model could take more. 0 uses only the model's own window. Lower costs less; higher remembers more.
config.forge.context.maskOldResults.desc: Do not resend old tool output (files read, command logs) on every step: replace it in the prompt with a one-line note. Your chat history is unchanged, and Forge can read the file again if it needs it.
config.forge.memory.enabled.description: Load project memory (.forge/MEMORY.md) into every run and let Forge save to it. Turn off for runs that should start from a blank slate.
config.forge.memory.injectionBudgetBytes: How many bytes of memory go into the prompt of each run. When memory is larger, Forge sends an index plus the entries most relevant to your request. Lower costs less; higher remembers more.
config.forge.memory.maxBodyChars.descrip: Longest memory entry Forge may save, in characters. Longer entries are refused so memory stays short facts, not documents.
config.forge.memory.autoApproveWrites.de: Save memory entries without asking first. Off by default: the approval shows exactly what will be remembered, and removing an entry always asks.
config.forge.context.keepRecentTurns.des: How many of the latest steps keep their full tool output when old results are masked.
config.forge.compaction.threshold.descri: Fraction of the model's context window at which compaction starts.
config.forge.completionDebounceMs.descri: How long to wait after the last keystroke before requesting a completion.
config.forge.completionMaxTokens.descrip: Max tokens the model may emit for an inline completion. Higher values allow multi-line suggestions.
config.forge.completionModel.description: Model used for inline completions. Defaults to a fast/cheap model for the chosen provider.
config.forge.completionEnabled.descripti: Turn inline completion on or off. Off sends nothing to the completion model, even from the trigger key.
config.forge.completionAutomatic.descrip: Suggest while you type. Off: suggestions come only when you press the trigger key (Ctrl+Alt+Backslash by default).
config.forge.completionTelemetry.descrip: Count how often completions are shown and accepted. Local-only: no network calls. Surfaces accept rate in the status bar tooltip.
config.forge.maxCostUsd.description: Stop a run once its cost reaches this many USD. 0 = no cap. Only applies to models with known pricing.
config.forge.goalMaxTurns.description: The most turns a /goal runs before it pauses and waits for you. Resume it with /goal resume.
config.forge.commandSandbox.description: Run commands in an OS sandbox (bubblewrap on Linux, sandbox-exec on macOS) that can write only to the workspace and temp folder; on-network keeps internet access. Not available on Windows.
config.forge.maxSteps.description: Steps (model calls) one chat run may take; the last one summarises what is left, and Continue carries on. 0 = no limit.
config.forge.loopGuardThreshold.descript: Stop a run after this many identical tool calls in a row (same tool, arguments and result; invalid or denied calls count too). 0 = off; 1 counts as 2.
config.forge.notifications.enabled.descr: Show a notification when a chat run finishes or stops while the VS Code window is not focused.
config.forge.language.description: Language of Forge's text in the chat, Settings and messages; auto follows the VS Code display language. Reload the window after changing it.
config.forge.caCertificates.description: PEM files of extra certificate authorities to trust, for company networks that re-sign TLS. Reload the window after changing it.
config.forge.keepAwake.description: Keep the computer from sleeping while a chat run is working, so a long task is not cut off. Windows, macOS and Linux with systemd.
config.forge.notifications.sound.descrip: Play a short system sound when a chat run finishes or stops while the VS Code window is not focused. Needs no other notification setting.
config.forge.notifications.osToast.descr: Show a desktop notification (Windows, macOS, Linux with notify-send) when a chat run finishes or stops while the VS Code window is not focused.
config.forge.notifications.minSeconds.de: Only notify for runs that took at least this many seconds.
config.forge.mcp.enabled.description: Connect MCP servers from ~/.forge/mcp.json (and .forge/mcp.json in trusted workspaces) and expose their tools to the agent.
config.forge.model.description: Default model id. Leave empty to use each provider's recommended default.
config.forge.provider.description: Default AI provider. 'auto' picks based on which API key is set (Bedrock, Vertex, Azure and local servers are never auto-picked; choose them explicitly).
config.forge.providers.awsRegion.descrip: AWS region for the Bedrock provider (falls back to AWS_REGION, then us-east-1). Credentials: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK or AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID + AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
config.forge.providers.azureBaseUrl.desc: Full Azure OpenAI base URL, instead of a resource name (falls back to AZURE_OPENAI_BASE_URL).
config.forge.providers.azureResourceName: Azure OpenAI resource name (falls back to AZURE_RESOURCE_NAME). The model id is your deployment name; the key is AZURE_API_KEY.
config.forge.providers.lmstudioBaseUrl.d: LM Studio server URL (falls back to LMSTUDIO_BASE_URL, then http://localhost:1234/v1).
config.forge.providers.ollamaBaseUrl.des: Ollama server URL (falls back to OLLAMA_BASE_URL, then http://localhost:11434/v1).
config.forge.providers.openaiCompatibleB: Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1 (falls back to OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_BASE_URL). Key: OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_API_KEY.
config.forge.providers.vertexLocation.de: Vertex region (falls back to GOOGLE_VERTEX_LOCATION, then us-central1).
config.forge.providers.vertexProject.des: Google Cloud project for the Vertex provider (falls back to GOOGLE_VERTEX_PROJECT). Auth uses Application Default Credentials.
config.forge.router.cheapModel.descripti: Model used for read-only exploration steps: a model id (same provider), an alias from ~/.forge/config.json, or provider:model. The main model is still used for planning and edits. Empty = always use the main model.
config.forge.cachePrompts.description: Add prompt-cache breakpoints for Anthropic models (Anthropic API and Bedrock). Cuts the cost of long agent runs. Other providers cache automatically.
config.forge.architect.enabled.descripti: Architect mode: the main model explores read-only and writes a change plan, then the editor model applies it. Needs Forge › Architect: Editor Model.
config.forge.architect.editorModel.descr: Model that applies the architect plan: a model id, an alias from ~/.forge/config.json, or provider:model.
config.forge.semanticSearch.description: Give the agent a codebase_search tool (semantic search over an index in .forge/index). Uses an offline embedder unless FORGE_EMBED_PROVIDER is set.
config.forge.terminal.integrated.descrip: Run the agent's shell commands in a visible Forge terminal (with shell integration) instead of a hidden process.
config.forge.verify.auto.description: Run the project's own typecheck, lint and test commands after the agent edits files, and send failures back to the model. 'ask' asks once for each set of commands, 'on' runs them without asking, 'off' never does. Commands you list in forge.verify.commands always run.
config.forge.verify.lsp.description: After the agent edits files, check them with their language server (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust) and send errors back to the model. Needs the language server installed.
config.forge.verify.commands.description: Commands (tests, lint, typecheck) run after the agent edits files. Failures are sent back to the model so it can fix them.
config.forge.voice.autoSubmit.descriptio: Auto-submit the transcript after the user stops speaking. Off by default: typing wins.
config.forge.voice.continuous.descriptio: Keep listening after each utterance. Useful for long dictation sessions.
config.forge.voice.enabled.description: Enable voice input in the chat panel (Web Speech API). Off on hosts that don't expose SpeechRecognition.
config.forge.voice.interimResults.descri: Surface interim transcripts as the user speaks. Off finalizes only when the engine says so.
config.forge.voice.language.description: BCP-47 language code for speech recognition (e.g. 'en-US', 'fr-FR'). Empty uses the runtime default (navigator.language).

config.forge.repoMap.tokens.description: Add a ranked outline of the codebase (files and the signatures of their main symbols, most-depended-on first) of about this many tokens to the system prompt, so the agent can navigate without reading everything. Files and names in your request are ranked higher. 0 turns it off.
config.forge.autoLint.enabled.descriptio: After the agent writes a file, check its syntax (tree-sitter) and run the commands in forge.autoLint.commands on it, and send any problems back to the agent in the same step so it fixes them.
config.forge.autoLint.commands.descripti: Linter command per file extension, run on each file the agent writes when forge.autoLint.enabled is on. The file path is appended. Keys are extensions without the dot ("ts", "py") or "*" for any other file. Example: { "ts": "npx eslint", "py": "flake8" }.
config.forge.autoCommit.enabled.descript: In a git repository, commit what the agent changed after each completed run, with a commit message drafted from the diff (by the cheap model if forge.router.cheapModel is set). Forge commits are marked so they can be told apart from yours. Off by default.
config.forge.autoCommit.dirtyCommits.des: With auto-commit on, first commit your own uncommitted changes in a separate commit, so the agent's commit holds only its changes. When off, your uncommitted files are left alone and stay out of the agent's commit.
config.forge.autoCommit.attribute.descri: With auto-commit on, add " (forge)" to the author and committer name of the agent's commits.
config.forge.autoCommit.runHooks.descrip: With auto-commit on, run your git pre-commit hooks on the agent's commits. Off by default, so a slow or failing hook cannot block a run.
config.forge.webSearch.provider.descript: Give the agent a web_search tool. "auto" uses the first backend with a key: TAVILY_API_KEY, BRAVE_API_KEY, or forge.webSearch.searxngUrl / SEARXNG_URL. Search queries are sent to that service.
config.forge.webSearch.searxngUrl.descri: Base URL of a SearXNG instance with JSON output enabled (for example http://localhost:8080), used when forge.webSearch.provider is "searxng" or "auto".
config.forge.docs.description: Documentation sources for @docs:<name> mentions: name -> URL, e.g. { "vite": "https://vite.dev" }. The page's /llms.txt is used when the site publishes one.
command.forge.inlineEdit.title: Forge: Edit with Forge
command.forge.explainSelection.title: Forge: Explain Selection
command.forge.fixDiagnostic.title: Forge: Fix Problem
config.forge.github.enabled.description: Give the agent GitHub pull-request tools for this repository: read a PR's reviews, line comments, discussion and checks, and open a draft PR (always asks first). Uses your VS Code GitHub sign-in, or GITHUB_TOKEN.
command.forge.spec.sync.title: Forge: Sync Spec with Code
config.forge.compaction.keepRecent.descr: How many of the latest messages stay word for word when older ones are condensed.
config.forge.tools.maxOutputChars.descri: Longest output a command may return to the model per stream. Longer output keeps its start and end and drops the middle.
config.forge.commitMessage.language.desc: Language for commit messages Forge writes, for example German or Japanese. Empty = English.
config.forge.commitMessage.prompt.descri: Your own instructions for drafting a commit message (language, style, gitmoji, length). Replaces Forge's built-in instruction; the diff is added after it. Empty = conventional commits.
config.forge.enhancePrompt.instruction.d: Your own instructions for the Enhance prompt button (for example: rewrite as a numbered checklist). Replaces Forge's built-in instruction; your draft is added after it. Empty = the built-in rewrite.
config.forge.shiftTabCyclesVariant.descr: Shift+Tab in the chat box cycles the reasoning effort (provider default, low, medium, high) instead of moving keyboard focus. Off by default so keyboard navigation keeps working.
config.forge.memory.sessionDigest.descri: When you start a new chat, summarise the chat that just ended (two to five lines: what changed, which files, what is left) into a dated section of the project memory. Uses the cheap model if one is set. Chats with fewer than two of your messages are skipped. Off by default; turning it on is your consent to these saves.
config.forge.semantic.embedder.descripti: Which embedder ranks code search results. env = the FORGE_EMBED_PROVIDER environment variable (offline word matching when unset); hashing = offline word matching; openai and ollama use their embedding models; custom uses your own OpenAI-compatible endpoint below.
config.forge.semantic.model.description: Embedding model name for openai, ollama or custom. Empty uses the provider's default (text-embedding-3-small, nomic-embed-text).
config.forge.semantic.baseUrl.descriptio: For the custom embedder: the OpenAI-compatible endpoint, up to and including /v1 (Forge adds /embeddings).
config.forge.semantic.apiKeyEnv.descript: For the custom embedder: the NAME of the environment variable that holds the key. The key itself is never stored in settings.
config.forge.semantic.batchSize.descript: How many text chunks go in one embedding request. 0 uses the default (64).
config.forge.semantic.resultLimit.descri: How many results code search returns when the model does not ask for a number. 0 uses the default (8).
config.forge.semantic.minScore.descripti: Leave out code search hits less similar than this (0 to 1). 0 keeps every hit.
config.forge.semantic.extensions.descrip: File types to index for code search, as a comma list such as ts, tsx, py, md. Empty uses the common source and Markdown types.
